inputs.prompt: Image 1 is a rough 3D layout, image 2 its depth (near = white). Turn image 1 into a photorealistic photograph: keep the camera, the framing and every object's shape and place exactly as in image 1; realistic materials, natural light.
inputs.system_prompt: You are a visual effects artist. Keep the geometry, the camera and the layout of the first picture exactly as they are; change only its look into a photograph. Always answer with an image.
